vo_brief_m01.text: GHOST, this is ORACLE. You go in tonight through the western perimeter. Get through the security checkpoint, reach the control terminal in the admin block and pull the initial intelligence package. Then out through the loading yard to the east. Their guards are contractors, not soldiers, but they are armed and they patrol. Stay in the shadows, keep it quiet, and nobody needs to know we were there.

vo_brief_m02.text: The communications sector is wired tight. Cameras in every corridor, and security specialists who will run for an alarm panel the moment they see you. Find the security control room and take their surveillance relays offline, then pull the classified communication files from the server hall. Downloading those files will trip a network lockdown. When it does, survive until the uplink completes, then get to the roof. Use the service ducts, use the disruptor, and remember that specialists carry radios.

vo_brief_m03.text: This is the last run. Get through the blast doors into the restricted command area, then shut down the main security network from the research lab's network core. That unlocks the command sector. Voss is on site with his heavy response team. Fight him, or seal him inside the strategy room with the lockdown override. Either way he cannot be allowed to stop you. Take the ledger from the vault and get to the helipad. I'll have a bird waiting.

vo_m01_start.text: GHOST, ORACLE. You're on the ground west of Kestrel Ridge. There's a breach in the perimeter wall to your east, or take your chances at the main gate.

vo_m01_perimeter.text: You're at the wall. The checkpoint sits on the inner fence, south of the main road.

vo_m01_checkpoint.text: The checkpoint guard keeps an admin keycard on his desk. Lift it and the front door is yours.

vo_m01_inside.text: You're inside the fence. Admin block is east, past the warehouse and the container yard.

vo_m01_terminal.text: Terminal is ours. The archive door just unlocked. The package is in the south-east office.

vo_m01_intel.text: Package secured. Extraction is the east gate, past the loading yard. Go.

vo_m02_start.text: GHOST, you're at the service entrance of the communications sector. Cameras everywhere in there. Find the security control room first.

vo_m02_sector.text: You're in. The control room is on the east side of the sector. Watch for specialists. Blue visors, long range radios.

vo_m02_control.text: Security control room. Their relay grid runs through here. Take three relays offline. One is in this room, the other two are out on the sector network.

vo_m02_relays_done.text: Relays are down. Their camera grid is half blind. The server hall is north. Get me those files.

vo_m02_files.text: Download started, and there it is. They've locked down the sector. Hold out until the uplink completes. Ninety seconds.

vo_m02_survive_done.text: Uplink complete. The lockdown is lifting on the roof stairwell. Get up there.

vo_m02_log.text: That's the encrypted transmission log. Good find. The buyers' keys are in there.

vo_m03_start.text: Last run, GHOST. The blast doors to the restricted command area are ahead. Voss's people are on high alert tonight.

vo_m03_restricted.text: You're past the blast doors. The research lab and its network core are on the west side.

vo_m03_network.text: Network core is down. Cameras are dark and the command sector door is open. Voss knows you're here.

vo_m03_command.text: Command sector. Voss is in the strategy room with his response team. Fight him, or use the lockdown override on the gallery to seal him in.

vo_m03_voss_intro.text: You made it this far, ghost. It ends in this room.

vo_m03_voss_taunt.text: Every operative you're protecting has a price. I just collected it.

vo_m03_voss_contained.text: Strategy room sealed. Voss isn't going anywhere. The vault is open. Take the ledger.

vo_m03_voss_down.text: Voss is down. The vault is open. Take the ledger.

vo_m03_ledger.text: That's the ledger. Everything we need. The helipad is on the roof. The bird is inbound.

vo_alarm.text: They've raised the alarm. Break contact or find another route.

vo_debrief_m01.text: Package received. Northgate isn't building radios, GHOST. They're hiding a surveillance network inside them. Rest up. Black Signal is next.

vo_debrief_m02.text: The files confirm it. Black Signal is run from the command sector by the facility's own security commander, Elias Voss. He is selling our people, GHOST. One more night.

vo_end_1.text: GHOST, the package is clean. Every transfer, every name, every signature. Northgate's black network is finished.

vo_end_2.text: The tribunal has the files. Commander Voss's operation goes dark tonight, and the facility goes with it.

vo_end_3.text: No flags. No medals. No record you were ever there. That was always the protocol.

vo_end_4.text: Copy that, Oracle. Shadow Protocol complete. Coming home.

bark_guard_investigate.text: I'm going to check it out.

bark_guard_body.text: Man down! We've got a body!
